scope: Q1 decision layer formalization. Reads the existing official Q1 inference artifacts only; no retraining, no change to model features, folds, probabilities or the legacy integer-median grade column.
task: Replace the legacy integer conditional median (which never emits 5/6) with a non-forced cumulative-probability top-k rule, and calibrate the integer median onto the observed panel-mean scale.

target_universe.note: Aroma and Flavour acetaldehyde slots exist in the 52-column paper table but carry no label or official probability; they stay NA and are excluded here.

decision_rule.name: non_forced_cumulative_probability_topk
decision_rule.group_size: n = number of cells of that target in that outer fold
decision_rule.training_rate_ge5: mean(panel_weighted_median >= 5) over the other folds of the same target
decision_rule.training_rate_6: mean(panel_weighted_median >= 6) over the other folds of the same target
decision_rule.k5: round_half_even(training_rate_ge5 * n), clipped to [0, n]; 0 means the target/fold emits no grade 5
decision_rule.k6: round_half_even(training_rate_6 * n), clipped to [0, n]; 0 means the target/fold emits no grade 6
decision_rule.assignment_order: 1) promote the top-k6 cells by probability_rating_6 to grade 6; 2) among the remaining cells promote the top-k5 by probability_rating_ge5 to grade 5; 3) every other cell keeps min(legacy_integer_median, 4)
decision_rule.tie_break: descending probability, then ascending row position inside the group (independent of the sort implementation)
decision_rule.why_non_forced: Only 34/50 targets have any observed panel median >= 5 and 12/50 any = 6; forcing a 5/6 on every target (force>=1 variant) destroyed precision and panel-median MAE, so promotion is rate-calibrated per target and fold.

calibration.fold_definition: outer_fold from outputs/r2_raw_q1_20261026/rating_weights_and_folds.csv; one fold per beer, 3 folds

methods.linear: per (target, fold) ordinary least squares of panel_weighted_mean on the legacy integer median, fit on the other folds; rank-deficient fits fall back to the training mean
methods.isotonic: per (target, fold) isotonic non-decreasing fit of panel_weighted_mean on the legacy integer median, fit on the other folds, clipped outside knots; constant-score training folds fall back to the training mean
methods.style_linear: per (target, fold) OLS of panel_weighted_mean on [legacy integer median, fold-wise style mean]; the style mean is the training-fold mean panel_weighted_mean per tasting_category_fine from 1.csv, unseen styles fall back to the training global mean
methods.quantile: per (target, fold) marginal calibration: map each test integer median to its mid-rank among training medians, then to the training empirical panel_weighted_median quantile at that level (method='lower')

calibration.rounding_for_grade_like_metrics: numpy.rint (ties to even) then clip to [0, 6]

metrics.macro_spearman: per-target Spearman between prediction and panel_weighted_mean for targets with at least 3 distinct reference values, then nanmean (not computed for the calibration rows)
metrics.high_grade: truth = panel_weighted_median >= threshold; prediction = grade >= threshold; precision/recall are cell-level panel metrics, not per-taster accuracy
metrics.individual_weighted: raw 0-6 records from the external anonymized sensory table, weighted by weight_within_beer (total weight 12500); this is the legacy evaluand and is reported only as a contrast
metrics.lower_bound: panel_median_oracle_individual_level: predict the observed panel-weighted median for every cell and score it against the weighted raw records; this is the L1 information floor of the cell-identity-only predictor, not a model

outputs.q1__submission_wide_250x50.csv: beer rows sorted ascending, 50 target columns sorted ascending
outputs.verification.json: assertions against experiments/lead_review/q1/decision_topk_report.json and the paper handoff package

verification.non_forced_evidence: grade 5 count 188 < 198 observed and grade 6 count 16 < 19 observed; at least one (target, fold) has k5 = 0 and at least one has k6 = 0

reproduction.command: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/q1_official_20261028.py --source '<赛题附件目录>' --q1 outputs/task6_final_20261026/paper/tables --raw outputs/r2_raw_q1_20261026 --reference data/reference/zenodo23624915 --output outputs/q1_decision_20261028
